recurring.title: Recurring invoices
recurring.lede: Recurring invoices, set up once: TILL creates each due period as a draft for review, or issues it automatically if you chose that.
recurring.noWorkspaceHint: Open a set of books first, then you will see its recurring invoices here.
recurring.endedNow: The schedule has ended. Generated invoices are kept.

empty.title: No schedules yet
empty.hint: A schedule produces a recurring invoice by itself: a retainer, a subscription, a maintenance fee. Create the first one with “New schedule”.

history.title: Generated invoices
history.empty: This schedule has not generated an invoice yet. The next run creates the first one.
history.skippedHint: A waiting draft is yours: issue it by hand or discard it. Either way the schedule carries on by itself, and a discarded period is never billed again.

form.name: Name
form.autoIssueHint: Unchecked, each due period creates a draft for review. Checked, TILL issues the invoice immediately: sequential number, VAT and posting exactly as for a hand-issued invoice.
form.autoIssueConfirm: Issue automatically? From the next run on, TILL issues and posts every due invoice of this schedule without asking: sequential number, VAT and ledger entry, with nobody reviewing it first.

error.needs_positions: The schedule needs at least one position with a valid price.
error.end_before_anchor: The end date is before the first invoice. Choose an end date after the start.
error.schedule_ended: This schedule has ended and cannot be changed. Create a new one if needed.
error.invalid_input: One of the inputs is invalid. Check the cadence and the dates.
error.as_of_in_future: A date in the future cannot be run.
error.period_locked: The target period is locked. The draft is kept and will be issued once the period is unlocked.
error.illegal_transition: This period's document is in a different state than the schedule expects. Open it from the history.

Recurring.title: Recurring invoices
Recurring.body: A recurring schedule is the standing instruction to produce one invoice per period. Here you set rhythm, duration and content, and read for each schedule what every period produced: the run log links each generated invoice to its schedule. By default a run produces a draft for review, not an unattended posting; schedules are also paused and resumed here.
